summary_en: HYUGA PRIMARY CARE's board approved and recommended shareholders tender their shares in a management buyout by JG44 at 2,110 yen per share, with a minimum acceptance threshold of 1,518,400 shares (69.46% post-offer ownership) during a 30-business-day tender period from September 28 to November 10, 2026, resulting in delisting.
title_en: Notice Regarding Implementation of MBO and Recommendation to Tender Shares
translation_en_brief: On September 25, 2026, HYUGA PRIMARY CARE's board of directors approved a management buyout in which JG44, a newly established special-purpose acquisition vehicle, will make a public tender offer to acquire the company's common shares and warrant securities. The offer price for ordinary shares is fixed at 2,110 yen per share. The minimum acceptance condition requires JG44 and its related parties to hold 69.46% of outstanding shares (calculated as 1,518,400 shares based on 71,288 total voting rights as of March 31, 2026) following completion. The offer will run for 30 business days from September 28 through November 10, 2026. Three series of warrant securities issued in 2018, 2020, and 2021 will also be subject to the offer at specified prices. The board determined that fairness safeguards were established, including approval by all disinterested directors and absence of objection from all disinterested statutory auditors. Completion of this transaction is expected to result in the company's delisting from the Growth Market.
